$comment: Reconciles every file in supabase/migrations/ against production: applied (with its live version), mirror (repo reconstruction of live state built outside tracked migrations), unapplied (intentionally not applied, with a reason) or pending (merged, awaiting apply). liveOnly lists live rows with no file. Checked by web/scripts/check-migrations.mjs; see WORKFLOW.md § Database migrations.

files.note: Reconstruction of the pre-tracking base tables (sessions, vitals, exercises). sessions/exercises predate migration tracking; vitals was created live by create_vitals_table. exercises block corrected to the live shape (#435), matching 018. Still not faithful: sessions.id is uuid (live bigint) and sessions.date is date (live text M/D/YY), so a from-zero replay still fails at 007:64 (session_id bigint references sessions.id) and 008:53 (session_date_to_iso(text) on a date column) [reproduced in a local PGlite replay with auth stubbed; not run on a Supabase stack].
Owner RLS on sessions/vitals plus the exercises read policy; the live sessions/vitals equivalents were built under other names. The exercises policy name now matches live exercises_read (#435).
Table later dropped by 013.
vitals.source / sleep_score. No live counterpart identified; the columns were added outside tracked migrations.
Syncs the repo to the live vitals unit-suffix renames, readiness/soreness/notes and the 7-arg upsert_vital. Live upsert_vital has 11 args (see liveOnly 005_vitals_activity_columns).
watts→avg_watts, distance→distance_m. NOT the live row named 005_vitals_activity_columns, which is unrelated and has no file.
Header records the live name.

Backfill of the strength subsystem built live via Cowork/MCP, reproduced from pg_catalog. strength_set_metrics now declared with (security_invoker = on) as live (#435). The six other strength/exercise views are captured by 018, not 007.
Applied in two steps; the second pinned search_path.
Merged in #323, hand-applied 2026-11-06 (#429).

Applied 2026-11-17 in the Strava go-live sitting (#628), first of four. Sent byte for byte with `supabase db query --linked --file`, in one transaction with its schema_migrations row, not via apply_migration, which needs the SQL retyped inline; the row's created_by is therefore empty. Stored text md5 matches the file.

Applied 2026-11-17 (#628), same method as 011, as amended by #629 (provenance table, FORCE RLS dropped, RPCs record provenance) and #630 (P0003 race guard on both RPCs). Its in-migration self-test of both RPCs passed at apply. From here it is immutable: change it with a new migration.
Root-cause fix for #429. Applied 2026-11-09 01:06 UTC as postgres via apply_migration (#451); read-back in the PR body.
Applied 2026-11-13 via apply_migration (#500); verified no-op capture of the live table, read-back in the PR body.
Applied 2026-11-13 via apply_migration (#500); RLS probe and anon 42501 read-back in the PR body.

Applied 2026-11-14 via apply_migration (#428): backup_snapshots + both backup functions captured; backup_snapshot() is catalogue-driven (every public base table minus an exclusion array), payload schema v2. Coverage read-back and advisor diff in the PR body.

Applied 2026-11-15 via apply_migration (#435): captures public.exercises (live shape), its read policy and indexes, strength_set_metrics security_invoker, and the 6 live-only strength/exercise views; closing shape guard over all 8 objects passed. Verified no-op: pg_class oids and reloptions of all 8 objects identical before and after (read-back in PR #578). Shares the 018 prefix with 018_strava_backup_exclusion (grandfathered in check-migrations.mjs). Seed is supabase/seed/exercises.sql (never applied to production; fingerprint 149ed35cc65128b5ee354a997d7fdd79).
Applied 2026-11-17 (#628), same method as 011, immediately after 012: backup_snapshot() excludes the strava_* tables, and sessions_no_strava exists for agent sessions (#631).
Applied 2026-11-17 (#628), same method as 011, before the OAuth grant: the disconnect, revocation-purge and deletion-sync functions. Its self-test passed at apply.

Applied 2026-11-17 (#647) after two rolled-back trials, by the #628 method (CLI db query --linked --file, inside one begin/commit, as postgres) rather than apply_migration; the recorded statement's md5 matches the file. strava_activity_cache (the session page's 7-day Strava cache, policy-less, cascading from strava_session_links), backup_snapshot() exclusion, hourly sweep cron job strava-activity-cache-sweep. Its self-test passed at apply.

Applied 2026-11-25 1:13 am AWST (Australia/Perth) to production swdrueaserjzhuxnzmeu only, via Supabase MCP apply_migration with name 021_sessions_duration_min, as postgres. Not applied to SplitIQ dev. Generated sessions.duration_min plus sessions_no_strava extension (#216). PostgREST schema cache reloaded with NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema'.
